opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants

amount.raw: Maximum grant £20,000 for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, and Long-Term Research; £5,000 for Conferences, Lectures and Publications; £2,500 for Research and Travel grants

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations (UK and international) for New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions and Collections, Conferences/Lectures/Publications and Long-Term Research categories; individuals (sculpture historians, academics and conservators) for Research and Travel grants. Organisations must be registered. Not for individuals developing their own artistic practice.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, funding exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications, acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display. Applications considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open.

opportunities.title: Visiting Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Travel and subsistence: UK up to £600, Europe up to £700, rest of world up to £1,000; accommodation provided for the duration of the fellowship

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Academics, curators and researchers working on historic and contemporary sculpture (Visiting Research Fellowships); researchers with interests in Henry Moore specifically (Studios & Gardens fellowships); artists developing their practice through research (Artist Research Fellowships); established scholars for Senior Fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships enabling artists and researchers to spend a month using the Henry Moore Institute's facilities in Leeds or Henry Moore Studios & Gardens in Hertfordshire, including accommodation, travel and subsistence. Applications closed for 2026/27; next round opens in spring 2027.

opportunities.title: Dissertation Prize

amount.raw: £250 cash prize for BA dissertation and £250 cash prize for MA dissertation, plus Henry Moore Institute publications to the cover price value of £50

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BA and MA students of all disciplines who submitted a dissertation within the past academic year at a UK university, on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. Requires a letter from the academic institution and a letter of support from a tutor/supervisor.
opportunities.summary: Two annual prizes for extended pieces of writing on contemporary, modern or historical sculpture. Submissions for the 2026 prize will open in autumn.
